Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Flock_Horror_;_Dread_Wood_#3: Angelo and his friends are back to defeat another horror, giant vampire birds that feast on BLOOD! Will Club Loser save the day, or will the bloodsucking fiends defeat them once and for all?
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Jurassic_Park: IT'S JURASSIC PARK, IT'S A MASSIVE PARK! Filled with more dinosaurs and danger than you can shake a stick at. A slightly misguided scientist decides to give dinosaurs another chance, and thinks it would be great if the public could come and have a nose at them too.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Long_Unwinding_Road_;_A_: Come with Marc P Jones as he takes you through the beautiful green hills and valleys of Wales. Discover Wales' deep majesty and ancient history, with local voices at the fore.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Two_Chubby_Cubs_;_Dinner_Tim: A lively romp with the Two Chubby Cubs, married couple Paul and James, giving us plenty of filthy giggles and dinner-time inspiration
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Hairy_Bikers_;_Ultimate_: A cosy, comforting cookbook delivered by two gently hairy bikers. Filled with love and light and wholesome goodness.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Wild_Abandon_;_A_Journey_to_: Jennifer Barclay picks up her backpack and explores a cluster of Greek islands on the edge of Europe. From volcanoes to beaches, she ensures no stone is left unturned, and finds a special kind of peace amongst deserted places and forgotten homes.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Assassin's_Apprentice_;_The_: Fitz was born out of wedlock to the crown prince, and for that, he is hated. Join Fitz as he learns the politics and intrigue of the palace whilst being raised in the stables. Does he have a touch of the Farseer magic that is so vied for by the royal family?
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Dee_Valley_Killings: As DI Ruth Hunter deals with the disappearance of her lover, she is suddenly handed a case that is so extreme she has no doubt it is the work of a practiced killer. Together with her fiercely Welsh partner, they must identify the suspect, even if it may be close to home
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Zero_Days: Jack and her husband, Gabe, are the best in the business when it comes to hacking security systems and breaking into buildings. When an assignment goes wrong, Jack comes home to find Gabe dead and what can only make it worse is that there is only one suspect — her.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Cream_Tea_Killer: Amateur sleuth Morwenna is looking forward to a bit of normality, until the local DJ she was supposed to be meeting washes up at the beach. Despite being dubbed The Cream Tea Killer, they are anything but sweet and it is up to Morwenna to unmask them.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Southern_Book_Club's_Gui: Patricia Campbell is used to the monotony of life. Kids, husband, book club. Until one day a neighbour dies and her house is inherited by her handsome nephew who seems a bit too good to be true. He's helpful, he's kind, he's...a vampire?
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Book_of_Azrael: He was a God; she was a demon—can I make it any more obvious? A true enemies to lovers and all the way back again, with her being the morally grey naughty one for a change.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Bury_Our_Bones_in_the_Midnig: A sensual slow burn about immortal love and what drives us to obsession. Dark, sapphic, beautiful vampires. Yes please.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_How_to_Stop_Time: Discover immortality as it has never been explored before. A historical fantasy about finding yourself, and learning how to live by the hand of Tom Hazzard, who has been alive for barely 400 years.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Ballad_of_Jacquotte_Dela: Get ready for a pirate adventure following Jacquotte’s rise to the captaincy. Join her, her friends, and the woman she falls in love with in this epic tale of overcoming hardships and empowerment.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Boys_run_the_riot,_Vol._1: Ryo, a trans teen fed up with gender rules (especially skirts), finds freedom in fashion. Teaming up with a rebellious classmate, they start a clothing brand to express themselves beyond labels. A bold, queer and stylish manga about self-acceptance and friendship.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Boys_run_the_riot,_Vol._2: In volume two of this heartfelt manga, trans teen Ryo and rebel Jin have launched their DIY fashion brand Boys Run the Riot, but Ryo struggles with coming out. Can he stay true to himself and still make it in fashion?
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Cemetery_Boys: A trans teen determined to prove to his Latinx family that he’s a brujo tries to summon his cousin’s spirit to solve his death, but ends up instead with a ridiculously handsome ghost. A hauntingly cute paranormal romance and mystery perfect for spooky season.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_To_live_forever: Climb the castes, and slave your life away for a slim chance to get immortality, or live free and get legally executed at 80. Gavin Waylock’s got one goal: cheat death, dystopian-style.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Declaration_of_the_Rights_of: "Woman has the right to mount the scaffold; she must equally have the right to mount the rostrum [speaking platform]." French revolutionary Olympe de Gouges flips the male-only Declaration of Human Rights, in this fearless and witty manifesto for gender equality.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Mini_ADHD_Coach;_Tools_a: An illustrated ADHD survival guide! The Mini ADHD Coach teaches you to hack hyperfocus, beat time blindness, manage chaos, and thrive daily with humor and zero shame for your wonderfully messy brain.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Book_of_the_City_of_Ladi: Guided by three allegorical figures, a woman builds a symbolic city with walls protecting women from slander and misogyny, celebrating their courage, wisdom, and achievements—radically ahead of its time in 15th-century Europe.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Emperor's_New_Clothes: A vain emperor loves new clothes so much, he’ll believe anything, especially when swindlers promise him a magical outfit only the ‘wise’ can see. A hilarious tale of vanity, flattery, and adults taking themselves way too seriously.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Story_of_Sinuhe: Exiled by deadly court intrigues, will Sinuhe survive foreign lands, outwit ruthless foes, and someday return to his beloved homeland? A thrilling adventure fiction that was once a bestseller in Ancient Egypt’s XXth Dynasty.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_An_Unkindness_of_Ghosts: On a deeply stratified spaceship, Aster uses her wit and courage to defy oppression. An afrofuturist, queer, and fiercely feminist journey.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Red_Virgin_;_Memoirs_of_: In her memoirs, Louise Michel recounts her life as a revolutionary activist and educator, from the Paris Commune to her exile in New Caledonia. A true heroine of her time, the “Red Virgin” affirms her anarchist, feminist, and anti-colonialist commitments.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Ugly_Duckling: Too big, oddly gray, and terribly clumsy, a poor duckling is teased by everyone. But when spring comes, he discovers he’s grown into a graceful swan. A heartwarming tale about feeling out of place, finding your wings, and realizing you were awesome all along.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Little_Mermaid: A young mermaid saves a prince from drowning and falls hopelessly in love. She trades her voice for a chance to walk among humans. A tragic, romantic tale of longing and sacrifice, inspired by Andersen’s own unrequited love for a man.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Nightingale: An emperor falls for a nightingale’s song, but when a flashy mechanical bird appears, everyone forgets the real nightingale, and he flies away. A poetic tale that reminds us that no technology can truly capture the beauty of nature or one's talent.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Thumbelina: Born from a flower, tiny Thumbelina drifts past marriage-minded toads, moles, and bossy swallows, trying to find a home where she’s loved, not used. A sweet fairy tale about finding where you belong.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Women,_Race_and_Class: In this groundbreaking essay, Angela Y. Davis explores the intersections of race, class, and gender, and how these factors shape the experiences of women in society. A foundational text in intersectional feminist theory.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Romancero_Gitano: Eighteen romances (a metrical form used in Spanish poetry), portraying the pride, resistance and suffering of the Romani people, their legends and traditions, and revealing the hidden soul of Andalusia through rich symbolic and surrealist poetry.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Code_Book_;_The_Science_: Crack codes, unravel secrets, and explore gripping historical mysteries. From ancient ciphers to World War II’s Enigma, Singh invites you to learn cryptography and test your skills with real code-breaking exercises.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Design_Patterns_;_Elements_o: The classic reference for object-oriented programming, written by the legendary Gang of Four: a catalogue of reusable solutions to that solve common problems and make your code cleaner, reusable, and future-proof.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Motivation_To_Create_;_1: A committed toolkit for staying creative while dodging burnout, AI overlords, and fascist funding cuts. Build habits, sell your art, spark change and keep your sanity (mostly) intact.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_All_She_Was_Worth: How desperate is a person who steals another's identity? Detective Honma searches for his nephew's missing fiancée, unravelling grim crimes to uncover the true Shoko since the dead leave traces in the living.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_If_the_Stars_Are_Lit: Joss Carsten is the only survivor of a starship explosion, so there's no way that Alice, her ex-wife, is truly in front of her! Yet she is, created as a sentient AI which the ship thought would help Joss survive.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Point_of_Hopes;_(Astreiant_#: What happens when Rathe, a stubborn Astreiant watchman, pairs up with Philip, an intelligent (and handsome) soldier? Adventure, intrigue, a bit of romance, and the successful rescue of stolen children!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Little_House_in_the_Big_Wood: Little Laura learns that each season has its work (autumn's busy harvest), and yet each season has its joy too (wintery maple syrup)! First in a series perfect for young readers, welcome to life in 1870s Wisconsin!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Chicago_Manual_of_Style_: Are you playing pin-the-hyphen with your sentences? Currently lost in a forest of commas? Worry no more, with 200+ pages of writing rules for publications, in this vintage style guide used by academics and (some) trade publishers!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Next_100_Years;_A_Foreca: "Russia and China collapse in the early 2020s, Japan experiences a resurgence to power, and 2050 sees WWIII happening. Is this a parallel world? Nope! It's (so far) an out-of-date political forecast!"
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Ghost_Map;_A_Street,_a_C: Two different paths converge, and between John Snow (physician) and Henry Whitehead (reverend), the source of London's 1854 cholera outbreak is chased down to a single public water pump on Broad Street.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Where_the_Sidewalk_Ends: With poems about hooks (don't scratch) and snakes (don't stretch). Sisters for sales and Peggy Ann, who ails. Boars, and crocs, and hats (no clocks?). Come for a giggle, just laugh aloud, and try not to wriggle!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Watership_Down: A journey of rabbits to find a new home, where they'll have to outwit enemies, "allies," and what seems to be every single one of the Prince's Thousand Enemies, for even when you reach the end, you find it's not that simple.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Say_Cheese_and_Die!;_Goosebu: Chills, thrills, and plenty of goosebumps! Read these spine-tingling horror books where nothing is quite like it seems, and be careful! There are demonic cameras, Monster Blood (don't swallow), and wishes you can't take back.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Mousetrap_and_Other_Play: A locked room mystery in a snowbound bed and breakfast by The Queen of Crime. Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Representative_Plays_of_: A selection of lesser-known plays from the playwright most famous for Peter Pan. This collection features Quality Street, The Admirable Crichton, What Every Woman Knows, Dear Brutus, The Twelve-Pound Look, and The Old Lady Shows Her Metals.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Glass_Menagerie: If you think your family life is dramatic, this story may cast things in a new light. This tense play is about a son and daughter living with their fragile mother’s mental illness and broken dreams. Talk about mama drama!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Year_in_Tokyo;An_Illustrat: Australian content creator and author Christy Ann Jones shares how to appreciate the city of Ginko leaves in this beautifully illustrated guide. A sketchy internship, translation mishaps, and culture shock, balanced by the best chicken katsu and the cutest bookshops!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Elsewhere;One_Woman,_One_Ruc: Rosita reflects on the life-changing experiences and people she met on nine journeys, from a chaotic bus ride in Pakistan to a healing swim in Bali, carrying only a rucksack and a diary. An emotion-filled collection of essays, both thrilling and heartbreaking.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_84,_Charing_Cross_Road: An epistolary memoir about a friendship that develops over a shared love of books. A lighthearted, humorous collection of letters between a bookseller in London and a writer in New York City, desperate to fill gaps in her collection.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Ship_of_Magic;Liveship_Trade: Only a liveship carved from wizardwood can trade on the deadly waters of the Rain Wild. Althea wants nothing more than to captain her own. Shrewd negotiations, betrayals, and wondrous discoveries await! One of two entry points to a 16-book series.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Home_Before_Dark: Her father's last words were: “Stay away from the house, it’s not safe for you.” Maggie gives her word. But later, she discovers she's inherited the spooky house that made her father famous. Can't hurt to visit... right? A horror/thriller with a book-within-a-book format.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Dream_First,_Details_Later;H: Helpful advice for getting your dream off the ground, running a business, and running with the right people, served up in a colorfully designed book from chef/entrepreneur Ellen Bennett.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Tenant_of_Wildfell_Hall: Gilbert is curious about Helen, the quiet woman who moved into Wildfell Hall with her young son. A gothic romance novel with feminist themes. So ahead of its time that Anne's sister Charlotte hid it from publishers until after Anne's death.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_North_and_South: The Industrial Revolution in England! Social Justice! Romance? Margaret and John's motivations clash over the working conditions in a dangerous cotton mill. Victorian literature has never seen more productive yearning.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Wide_Sky,_Narrow_Path;A_View: A poetic memoir about the author's journey through-hiking the Appalachian Trail from Georgia to Maine. Courtney shares the harsh realities and stunning beauty of the trail alongside her intimate reflections on spirituality.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Mr._Penumbra's_24-Hour_Books: Clay has some digital marketing experience. So when he's hired on the night shift at Mr Penumbra's, he’s puzzled about why it's still in business. Most customers only borrow books from the highest shelves in the store. A fantastical quest story set in a San Francisco bookstore!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_On_Earth_as_It_Is_on_Televis: When the aliens suddenly turn around, seemingly without any message of threat or peace, Earth doesn’t really know how to move on. Some of us made too many end-of-the-world changes to go back. Extraterrestrial and existential crises abound.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Study_in_Charlotte;Charlot: Jamie Watson has admired the coldly intellectual Charlotte Holmes… from a distance. But when another boarding school student dies in a manner identical to a Sherlock Holmes story, the young adult descendants of Holmes and Watson must team up to find the killer.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Who_Could_That_Be_at_This_Ho: Readers are discouraged from reading this book about a pre-teen training as a secret agent in a strange town. It would also be better if you avoid drinking coffee and listening to classical jazz while doing so. Book one of a series better left unpublished.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Escape_from_Mr._Lemoncello's: Kyle Keeley never met a puzzle he didn't like. So he’s thrilled when a famous game maker invites him and 12 other kids to an overnight lock-in, the grand opening of the town library. In the morning, the doors are still locked. Solve the puzzles and escape the library!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_This_Book_Will_Bury_Me: After her father's death, Janeway finds a vehicle for her grief and unanswered questions: true crime discussion boards. She'll do anything to chase down new leads on a cold case, but her new online friends are hiding dark secrets of their own. An unputdownable thriller!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Maid;Molly_the_Maid_#1: The first book in a mystery series with a lovable, neurospicy protagonist at its heart. Molly loves her job cleaning rooms at the Regency Grand Hotel, but her gullibility makes her both an unreliable narrator and the perfect suspect for a murder mystery!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Death_of_Mrs._Westaway: Hal's faking it, but barely making it as a fortune teller. When she receives an invitation to the will-reading of a stranger, she assumes the identity of the addressee to see if her fate can change. But greater threats await. A gothic thriller, perfect for a rainy day!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Welcome_to_the_Hyunam-Dong_B: She doesn't have many customers, but Yeongju hopes to keep her bookshop open just a little longer. She hires a barista, invites guest speakers, and starts a book club. A cosy Korean bestseller about savouring the simple joys in life over chasing productivity.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Vanishing_Stair;Truly_De: After the murder last year, Stevie's parents don't want her at Ellingham Academy. But Stevie will do anything to return, even make a deal with a shady politician. Anything to get back to her friends, the boy she kissed, and her work on the Truly Devious case!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Examiner: The Royal Hastings University Multimedia Art course: One Instructor, Six Students, One Murder. This dark academia crime story puts you in the chair of the examiner, with access to all the emails, project reports, chat threads, and other documents from the class!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Lighthouse_Mystery;The_B: Henry, Jessie, Violet, and Benny's days in a boxcar are behind them. Now they travel the world, solving mysteries nobody wanted their help with! This summer, the siblings are asleep in a lighthouse when their dog Watch wakes them, barking at something unseen.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Maisie_Dobbs;_Book_1: Housemaid, college student, frontline nurse. Maisie has honed her observation skills in many settings, so after the War, she decides to become a private investigator. Her first assignment seems like a simple case of infidelity, but it hides a bigger conspiracy.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Unusual_Suspects;The_Sis: Granny Relda tells Sabrina and Daphne the truth about their legacy. That classic book of fairytales? It's actually a casebook of magical crimes. Oh, and their new school in Ferryport Landing may have monsters. The second volume in a series of fractured fairy tales.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Mysterious_Benedict_Soci: Four children pass a series of curious tests to qualify for an undercover operation. Their mission: find out what's happening at the Learning Institute for the Very Enlightened. Contains buckets of friendship, weird inventions, and adventure!
38 tales from an American writer famous for surprise endings! Will Porter began writing short stories from prison in 1898. He later changed his name and started fresh in New York City. He wrote over 600 stories in his lifetime. Some aged better than others.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Europe_Through_the_Back_Door: Catch yourself thinking, "I could live here," on nearly every trip? Make the most out of your time in Europe by acting like you already do. Let TV-famous travel guide Rick Steves teach you how to connect with locals, avoid scams, and have a stress-free trip.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_All_Systems_Red;The_Murderbo: Meet Murderbot, a SecUnit who recently hacked their governor chip. Too bad it keeps getting sent on planetary bodyguard contracts for the shady Company! All this android wants is space to have an existential crisis and binge-watch their favourite program.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_War_and_Peace: A hefty chonk indeed. A famous historical novel with a meandering plot between — you guessed it: war and peace. As much about choosing the right life partner as it is about the Napoleonic Wars.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Unselected_Journals_of_E: Emma chronicles her romantic life at Lapis Lazuli House in a series of witty novellas that transport the reader to London, 1883. Your journal probably doesn't have a plot line, and neither does Emma's.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Paradise_Lost: A famously epic poem retelling the Christian creation and fall story. Betrayal, revenge, and a battle for ultimate dominance. In the beginning, there was drama!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Antony_and_Cleopatra: A tragic play set during the founding of the Roman Empire in 30 BC. Bask in the hot mess of a relationship between Egyptian Queen Cleopatra and Roman General Mark Antony.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Merry_Adventures_of_Robi: Follow the adventures of the merry bandit who robbed from the rich to give to the poor. Pyle, an American illustrator, wrote this version of the legend especially for children, and this edition features his humorous illustrations.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Hunchback_of_Notre-Dame: A gothic romance set in the dark and troubling streets of medieval Paris. Ring any bells? Each chapter is told by a different unlikeable character, and none of them are gargoyles, making this novel far more depressing than its animated adaptation.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Ella_Enchanted: You don't want Lucinda on your guest list. That fairy's magical 'gifts' don't come with a receipt! As she grew, Ella found her own ways to cope with her curse of obedience, but she'll need to go on a quest to break it. A romantic, empowering Cinderella story.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_East_of_Eden: A retelling of Genesis set on California farmland in 1865. This complex novel centres on the timeless struggles of two families, exploring themes of rivalry, identity, and love.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_On_the_Banks_of_Plum_Creek;(: Laura and her family leave their house on the prairie for Plum Creek in Minnesota. During the day, Laura and Mary go to school, do chores, and go fishing. At night, Pa's fiddle sings them to sleep. Fourth in a classic series perfect for little pioneers!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Dragonet_Prophecy;Wings_: A dark and character-driven YA series set in a world where dragons endlessly fight over treasure. Prophecy foretells that the sacrifice of a young dragon will end the war for good… But what if this promised dragon doesn't particularly want to fulfil their destiny?
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Green_Ember;_Book_1: Forced to flee their home, siblings Heather and Picket come to a hidden refuge where each rabbit trains their gifts to bring about a Mended Wood. Kids will love this series with its brave characters and themes of found family. Rabbits with swords!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Smile_in_the_Mind: A collection of the best examples of graphic design wit. This book features the work of more than 300 designers who created wink-worthy logos, ads, and packaging that invite the viewer inside the joke, with explanations about the brain science that makes them tick.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Art_of_the_Modern_Movie_Post: A lovely collection of over 1,500 vintage film posters, perfect for any film buff, poster-collector, or owner of a coffee table.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Unexpected_Mrs._Pollifax: Emily Pollifax is a widowed empty-nester who's always dreamt of becoming a spy. Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Maltese_Falcon: Private Eye Sam Spade is visited by a mysterious client who needs him to find her sister. She's lying. It's all about a golden bird! This classic crime novel also was also a smashing success with its 1941 film noir adaptation starring Humphrey Bogart.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Body_in_the_Library;Miss: The body of a young woman is found in the library at the Bantry estate. Before the police question the neighbours, Mrs Bantry suggests they consult Miss Marple, a silver-haired woman with a keen ear for village gossip and a keen eye for human nature.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Murder_is_Announced;Miss_M: A newspaper ad extends an open invitation to a murder mystery party at the home of Letitia Blacklock. But when the lights go out, a real murder takes place. Can Miss Marple find the killer? A classic whodunnit with a delicious plot twist that will make you RSVP 'Yes!'
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_What_You’re_Looking_For_is_i: A cosy novel about patrons who visit a library in Tokyo with their questions.This Japanese bestseller encourages the reader to identify what they're looking for, and savour the magical possibilities in the lives they touch and the pages they turn. Repetitive, calming, and sweet.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Field_Guide;The_Spiderwi: When Jared, Simon, and Mallory dust off a field guide to the hidden world of faerie, the siblings learn the dangerous, fantastical creatures are a little too close to their new home. Book one of a magical children's series.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Library_Book: A journalist's engaging investigation into the 1986 fire at the Los Angeles Public Library. Part true-crime story, part essay on what libraries mean to us, and why the burning of books or libraries is so devastating.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Sorcery_of_Thorns;_Book_1: Elisabeth grew up in a library of dangerous books. When the most dangerous grimoire of them all is unleashed, she's the prime suspect. But she suspects sorcerer Nathaniel Thorn is the real culprit. A darkly magical YA novel with Howls Moving Castle vibes.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_We_Solve_Murders;_Book_1: Amy is working as a bodyguard for a famous author on her private island when a body washes onshore. Thankfully, her father-in-law, Steve, is a retired police officer with plenty of free time on his hands! The first case in a series for this dynamic duo.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Bullet_That_Missed;A_Thu: Another week at Cooper's Chase retirement village, another cold case for Joyce, Elizabeth, Ibrahim, and Ron to solve. A stranger from Elizabeth's past arrives to threaten her, but the Thursday Murder Club always keep their confidences and protects their own!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Listen_for_the_Lie: Lucy doesn't want to be on a podcast about her best friend's murder. Her memory from that night is sketchy at best, and the town has already decided who's guilty. But true crime podcaster Ben is both persistent and attractive. Unputdownable and spicy!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Winnie_The_Pooh;The_Complete: Ten stories featuring a small bear and his friendly neighbours in the Hundred Acre Wood: Pooh, Piglet, Rabbit, Eeyore, Owl, Kanga, Little Roo, and Christopher Robin. Complete with full-colour illustrations, sure to Tigger, I mean trigger your nostalgia.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Five_Little_Peppers_and_How_: A cosy classic about five children and their mother, living in a little brown house, learning to be helpful and create their own happiness in lean times. Who knew baked goods and surprise visits could bring so much joy?
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Pollyanna;_Book_1: A little orphan girl with toxic positivity moves in with her cold matronly Aunt, and winds up changing the entire mood of their small town in Vermont. A classic book that inspired hundreds of children to start ‘gladness clubs’ (Yes, really).
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Caps_for_Sale;_A_Tale_of_a_P: A classic picture book about the dangers of taking naps under trees filled with monkeys. Hilarious and repetitive, what every child wants.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Eloise;A_Book_for_Precocious: A spoiled little girl runs wild at New York City's famous Plaza Hotel. She's six years-old, so she'll insist on telling you how things work here. Parents might classify this as a horror novel, but you'll love the clever illustrations.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_How_Winston_Delivered_Christ: A brave little mouse sets off on a quest to deliver a lost letter to Father Christmas on Christmas Eve. This picture book is designed to be read as an Advent calendar, and includes activities for children impatiently counting down the days till Christmas.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Frozen_River: As a midwife, Martha Ballard carefully records births, deaths, and any crimes in their small town of Hallowell, Maine. In 1789, Martha's diary becomes evidence in a trial that divides her community. A thrilling mystery based on a true story. Contains mature themes.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Hobbit;The_Lord_of_the_R: You never know what'll happen when you step outside your front door. Especially if a wizard left his mark on said door. Bilbo leaves his creature comforts behind to seek adventure with a company of dwarves, and winds up bringing home the worst souvenir possible.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Tuck_Everlasting: When Winnie is given the choice to drink water that grants eternal youth, the Tucks help her wrestle with a decision bigger than her ten years can handle. A classic middle-grade novel with beautiful prose and heartbreaking moments. Keep tissues nearby!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Blue_Castle: When 29-year-old Valancy gets bad news from her doctor, she decides she’s ready to live. She’s done letting her family dictate how she spends her days, and she offers friendship to the townsfolk they despise. A romantic and hopeful novel about second chances.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Enchanted_Castle: Gerald, Cathy and Jimmy's game of pretend begins quite ordinarily, but then turns frighteningly real. An enchanted garden, a sleeping princess, an invisibility ring, a pile of coats with its own personality, all alive with magic in this charming children's tale.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Wrong_Place_Wrong_Time: Jen saw her son murder a stranger, right outside their home. But when she wakes the next morning, it's yesterday. She has the time to change what happened. Each time she falls asleep, she wakes deeper in the past. A thriller with a shocking twist!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Gathering_Moss;A_Natural_and: A collection of essays about a vital, yet overlooked, piece of natural history. A scientist, mother, teacher, and writer of Native American heritage, Kimmerer explains the science behind mosses and how it relates to ways of living. A thoughtful read for all ages!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Mad_About_You: Harriet breaks up with her long-term boyfriend and moves into a rented flat. Turns out she's already met her new roommate: he left his fiancée on their wedding day, and she was the photographer. A slow-burn romance with more emotional layers than baklava!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_True_Crime_Story: In 2011, 19-year-old Zoe Nolan left a party at her flat and disappeared. Seven years later, writer Evelyn Mitchell is investigating the missing girl. Troubled by her findings, Evelyn consults Knox, a crime writer. A thriller so stacked with evidence, it feels real.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Chocolat;__Book_1: Vianne’s new chocolaterie is a refuge for the overlooked townspeople of Lansquenet. Customers are given a mug of bittersweet hot chocolate, a sympathetic ear, and just a touch of magic–much to the disapproval of the local priest.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Secret_Garden;A_Graphic_: When Mary Lennox arrives at her Uncle Craven's manor on the Yorkshire moors, she's very unhappy. There are too many rules for a ten-year-old girl in this house. But she's heard rumours of a secret garden... Could it be a place to call her own?
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Story_Girl;_Book_1: Fourteen-year-old Sara Stanley is a born storyteller. Both kids and grown-ups are captivated by her tales. Bev and his younger brother Felix spend a summer full of stories with their new friend Sara, hanging on her every word.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Belinda: Belinda has aspirations beyond London's social season. Amongst the heroine's witty observations of eighteenth-century society, this novel also touches on the challenging issues of feminism, racism, and obsession. One of Jane Austen's favourite books!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Thousand_Feasts;_Small_Mom: What if you could preserve the tiniest of moments before they are gone forever? The scent of a meal, the feel of a specific day. An essay collection of brief yet beautiful experiences from the author's travels, captured in prose like a leaf in amber.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Eugene_Onegin: Tatyana loves Eugene. Eugene thinks she's boring. Later, he wishes he had acted differently. A suspenseful Russian novel in verse with a large cast of characters and plenty of philosophy to chew on!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Anna_Karenina: An emotionally-charged Russian novel about love triangles, affairs, and farming. Wish you could be the hero of your own tragic story? Ride a sad train with Anna Karenina.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Bird_by_Bird;Some_Instructio: The most difficult part of writing is just getting started! Author Anne Lamott gently guides the aspirational writer through each step of the writing journey. Learn how to observe, reflect, and give yourself plenty of grace through the process!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Why_I_Am_Not_Going_to_Buy_a_: Do I wish to keep up with the times? No. My wish simply is to live my life as fully as I can.' A collection of essays explaining this great American novelist's reluctance to embrace a life of convenience and productivity.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Jayber_Crow;Port_William_#7: Jayber drops out of school and returns to his hometown, where he finds a clearer picture of life's miracles in his barbershop chair than in a thousand books. A touching and humorous novel set in 1932, following the loveable residents of Port William, Kentucky.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_And_The_World_Spins_Anyway: In the author's debut collection of poetry and short stories, she invites readers to take a step away from social media and feel a little less alone in this chaotic, beautiful world. A refreshing and relatable read.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Unseen_World: Twelve-year-old Ada Sibelius is a shy prodigy who follows her father to work in his computer lab every day. When her father's memory fails, adult Ada seeks answers by venturing into the virtual world herself. An emotional mystery novel with just a touch of sci-fi.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_We_Live_Here_Now: Emily and Freddie are a couple divided by their secrets. Although Emily is still experiencing paranoia post-surgery, she's fairly certain their new house, Larkin Lodge, is haunted. A gothic horror/domestic thriller with a surprising and philosophical twist!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Hamnet: Stratford-upon-Avon, 1596 – A marriage is on the rocks, and a sudden illness threatens the life of a child. A short, tragic, and intricate novel about the familial inspiration behind one of the world’s most famous plays. It never mentions the playwright by name!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Hello_Lighthouse_: A Caldecott Award Winning picture book. Say hello to a lighthouse keeper and his wife, guarding the coast through days of stormy waves and sunny skies, waiting for the arrival of their child. At the end, wave goodbye to the lighthouse on their return to the mainland.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Place_to_Hang_the_Moon: William, Edmund, and Anna need a guardian, so they slip into a crowd of evacuating London children, hoping to find a home. Nora, a friendly librarian, is the target of local gossip because of her German husband. But she has plenty of books, and makes a mean hot cocoa!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_There's_A_Ghost_In_This_Hous: Tour a spooky little house with a friendly little ghost! This creatively printed children's book alternates from grayscale illustrations to transparent vellum pages, so the pale ghost appears to float through the pages.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Three_Bags_Full;Sheep_Detect: A humorous murder mystery set on a hillside near Glennkill, Ireland. A flock of sheep are outraged that someone got away with murdering their shepherd, George. Can this eclectic cast of sheep detectives figure out who killed him? An absolutely baaa-tty first book.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Man_Who_Was_Thursday: A secret society, hell-bent on world domination, led by seven figures known only by days of the week. This comedic mystery follows a Scotland Yard detective hoping to dismantle the institution from the inside. His code name? Thursday.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Selected_Stories_of_Anton_Ch: 30 stories from the Russian writer and playwright, famous for his painterly prose and use of foreshadowing. This collection features The Huntsman, A Boring Story, The Lady with the Little Dog (a crowd-pleaser), and Chekhov's personal favourite, The Student.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Moorland_Cottage: Maggie suffers under the oppressive needs of her bitter mother and selfish brother. When a neighbouring family offers her a glimpse of the warmth she’s never known, she must choose between her burden of responsibility to her family and the call of true love.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Swann's_Way;In_Search_of_Los: A bite of cookie triggers the narrator's slow release of memories: his neighbour's daily walks, and his growing love for Swann's daughter, Gilberte. Proust liked writing in bed. No shame if his book puts you to sleep. Volume one of the world's longest novel.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Shady_Hollow;A_Shady_Hollow_: Today's Headline: Murder in Shady Hollow! Reporter Vera Vixen just moved to this cosy town of neighbourly creatures, but the fox immediately employs her journalistic skills to track down leads. She'll have to be careful, not every animal wants her to solve this mystery!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Sherlockian: The world's foremost Arthur Conan Doyle scholar is dead. In his possession was a diary detailing what happened in the 8-year gap when the author wasn't publishing Sherlock Holmes stories. Harold, a literary researcher, must employ Holmes’ methods to find the killer!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Unmaking_of_June_Farrow: Eventually, each Farrow woman begins to see, hear, and smell things that aren’t there, slowly unravelling their grip on reality. June is starting to see the signs. A mysterious novel about the doors we choose, and how those choices shape who we become and who we love.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Everyone_in_My_Family_Has_Ki: Shortly after Ernest arrives at a secluded ski lodge for the Cunningham family reunion, a body is found in the snow. Ernie writes how-to books for mystery writers. He knows the best rules, formulas, and tropes. But he's never been this close to this many suspects!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Last_Story_of_Mina_Lee: When 26-year-old Margot finds her mother's body in her Koreatown apartment, ruled a death by suspicious circumstances, she starts investigating for herself. A novel told in dual timeline, we also follow Mina's perspective during her first year in Los Angeles.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Greenglass_House;(Book_1): Milo has plans to exclusively munch on cookies and read books during his winter holidays. But thanks to a snowstorm, his parents' inn fills with guests, all strangely invested in the story of their house. A locked room mystery and a treasure hunt, with a surprise twist!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Invention_of_Hugo_Cabret: A mysterious tale about a young boy living in a Paris train station. With sparse pages of text, the story is told mostly through black-and-white illustrations, theatrically revealing tiny details of each scene–and Hugo's secret invention–one frame at a time.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Truly_Devious;_Book_1: Stevie Bell’s winning scholarship essay was about her hopes to solve Ellingham Academy's historically cold murder case. But in the present day, a new body is added to the killer's tally. Steve can handle being a detective, a student, and a good friend, right?
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Five_Survive: Red and her five friends are headed for Spring Break at the beach. But when their RV breaks down, the young adults are stranded. A killer plans to silence one of their group. Can they find out who they want before the night takes them all?
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Pygmalion: Professor Henry Higgins bets he can coach a socially awkward flower seller into passing as an aristocratic lady. He doesn't expect to fall in love with her. This humorous play pokes fun at classism in the 20th century, and was later adapted as the musical My Fair Lady.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Illustrated_Dust_Jacket,: In this collection of cover art, you'll see the historical evolution of style and intention in book jacket design: From practical tool to key marketing element. Go ahead and judge books by their covers!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Ficciones: 17 masterful short stories from the Argentinian writer and poet, famous for his maze-like prose. Fantastical, intellectual, and bizarre. This selection includes The Library of Babel, The Circular Ruins, and The God of the Labyrinth.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Infinite_Jest: A darkly comedic novel about addiction, depression, and tennis. The large number of pages and unlikeable characters make it a veritable mountain-climb of a read. You might finish it, it might finish you. Love or hate this book, you'll be in good company!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Blurb_Your_Enthusiasm;A_Crac: You pick up a book. What next? Maybe you read the hook on the back cover, the flaps, and the glowing blurbs authors give one another 'Astonishing!'... Did they even read it? Learn the humour and history behind the text outside of books! As meta as it gets.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_How_to_Say_Babylon: Safiya's father used fear and anger to control the women in his family, forbidding Western (Babylon) influences. But her mother silently handed her books. Education gave Safiya a voice, and this feminist memoir stands as proof of her power in its lyrical, poetic prose.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Island_of_Missing_Trees: A tale of forbidden love and common roots set on the divided island of Cyprus in 1974. This story is told through multiple perspectives, shifting time, place, and species. The main narrator is a fig tree!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Wind_In_The_Willows: This delightfully illustrated children’s book contains the misadventures of four well-intentioned friends: Mole, Badger, Rat, and every car salesman's dream, the out-of-control Mr Toad.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Princess_Bride: This fantasy story contains: battles of wit, feats of strength, rodents of unusual size, sword fights of revenge, and the truest of true love, all saturated with inconceivable levels of satire.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Mystery_of_the_Blue_Trai: Before boarding a luxury train to Nice, detective Hercule Poirot befriends Ruth, a troubled American heiress. By journey's end, his new friend has been murdered. It would seem the usefulness of the little grey cells is not exclusive to the Orient Express, eh?
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Trumpet_of_the_Swan: Louis is the trumpeter swan who can't. He wants desperately to call out to his crush, Serena, but he can't make a sound. But as this colorful children's book teaches, sometimes you just need a little creativity to express yourself!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Redwall;_Book_1: Welcome to Redwall– An abbey that offers the sanctuary of good food, warm fires, and brave tales. This world is not without its dangers, but if a humble mouse can claim a fabled sword, they might just go down in song and legend!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Olivetti: When its human family is in crisis, a vintage typewriter breaks the rules to communicate what they most need to remember. A heartfelt and beautiful middle-grade book!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_This_Golden_State: Seventeen year-old Poppy has never felt settled. Her family is always moving, always 'for their safety.' But she likes her new school and friends in California, and needs to know why it could all disappear. A mysterious YA novel about identity, belonging, and love.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Dreamer's_Pool;_Blackthorn_&: Two new friends start new lives after a magical escape. Blackthorn is a healer, Grim does physical labor. The duo's work on a local crime draws the Prince's attention. He needs their help with a problem of his own. A fantasy trilogy with slow-burn romance!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Far_from_the_Madding_Crowd: Bathsheba Everdene thinks she's all that. Three men are reluctant to contradict her and eager to win her affections. A foggy, moody novel in a provincial setting with tragic plot twists and beautiful nature writing.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Child's_Garden_of_Verses: A collection of sixty-six poems for imaginative children, accompanied by the gentle watercolour illustrations of Tasha Tudor.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Five_Children_and_It;Five_Ch: One summer at the beach, five siblings discover a Psammead, a fantastical creature who grants each of them a wish. Each wish's impact will only last for one day, which is for the best, given the inevitable need for damage control.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Anxious_People: An apartment showing becomes a hostage situation when a bank robber walks in. The catch: no one knows their identity! As the pressure builds, a collection of perfect strangers confess their deepest fears in this tender, mysterious, and funny story.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Last_Time_I_Lied: Emma remembers the night her cabin mates snuck out... Some of it. The memory gaps still haunt her. Fifteen years later, she reluctantly returns to camp Nightingale, and it feels like someone's waiting for her to break. A chilling and twisty YA thriller!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Housekeeper_and_the_Prof: A math professor with short-term memory loss develops a friendship with his housekeeper and her son. As his health fails, he begins to attach mathematical formulae to the minute details of their lives. An emotional and reflective novel.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Forgotten_Beasts_of_Eld: Sybel's closest friends are magical animals. She's more than content to avoid the war brewing in neighboring kingdoms. But when a soldier brings a human baby into her fantastical menagerie for safekeeping, her safe little world will never be the same.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Pallbearers_Club: He met her in the 1980s when he was seventeen and deeply uncool. She introduced him to the world of punk rock and challenged his disbelief in vampires. A slowly-building horror novel with critical annotations courtesy of its femme fatale.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Theft_of_Swords;_Ryria_Revel: Royce and Hadrian are thieves-for-hire who take only the most difficult jobs. On their latest heist, the two buddies are roped into a greater conspiracy that could impact the future of the entire kingdom. Friendship and betrayal, myths and legends await!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Little_Lord_Fauntleroy: Cedric, a middle-class American boy, learns he's heir to an English earldom. In the 1880s, this book popularised a trend in boys' fashion and set a legal precedent when the author insisted on compensation for theatrical adaptations of her work! Show me the money!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Turn_of_the_Screw: A young governess slowly realises the two children under her care are the target of the creepy ghosts who haunt the estate. The troubling part is that Flora and Miles seem perfectly fine with it. Worst job ever.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Lady_Audley's_Secret: A scandalous domestic thriller complete with a twisty murder mystery, and a layered anti-heroine. Surprisingly feminist for the Victorian era!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Bleak_House: A layered story about injustice and generosity, set amid the chaotic legal system of 19th-century London. The fortunes of many lie in the outcome of a twelve-year legal dispute. While lawyers quibble, drama, mystery, and tragedy unfold in the characters' daily lives.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Cook's_Tour;Global_Adventu: Experience global culinary adventures with beloved chef Anthony Bourdain! A savoury travel memoir in search of the perfect meal.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Death_in_Yellowstone;Acciden: Grizzly bear attacks, hot springs, and avalanches, oh my! Cautionary tales about what not to do in one of America's wildest national parks.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Three_Men_in_a_Boat;Three_Me: Three men (and a dog) decide to escape the drudgery of their jobs and boat down the Thames in this early example of work life balance. Case in point: the author started to write a travel guide, but gave the world this humorous novel instead!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Essential_Calvin_and_Hob: Follow the adventures of Calvin and Hobbes, his come-to-life stuffed tiger. From dangerous wagon rides to armies of snowmen, this dynamic duo could care less what girls or adults think of their imaginative pursuits. A graphic novel both hilarious and heartwarming.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Phantom_of_the_Opera: The Phantom holds a reign of terror over the Paris Opera House. He has a special place in his heart for Christine Daaé, the singer he's trained while masquerading as an angel of music. And he's easily jealous. This classic is way more murder-y than the musical.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Miracle_Worker;_A_Play: "When we do the best we can, we never know what miracle is wrought in our life, or in the life of another." This semi-biographical play tells the story of the life-altering friendship between Helen Keller and her teacher, Annie Sullivan.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Breakfast_at_Tiffany's: Holly Golightly may seem shallow and carefree, with her many suitors and piles of gifts. But as the young writer gets to know her–first out of curiosity, then attraction–he realises she's not cheap, she's priceless.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Devotions;_The_Selected_Poem: If you find yourself thinking about the short-lived nature of changing seasons, wishing you could sit by a stream and see what animals come to visit, or needing to slow down and just be, you'll find a companion in the poet Mary Oliver.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Adventures_of_Huckleberr: Mark Twain shows us the hypocrisy of 19th century Mississippi through the dawning understanding of a young boy's conscience. From the evils of slavery to toxic masculinity, Huck has to reckon with what he sees and decide for himself. And it takes him a while...
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Virgil_Wander: A tragic accident leaves Virgil with no memories. His small Midwestern town, his language, everything must be relearned with the help of a community facing its own set of tragedies. An emotional, character-driven novel that features magical realism.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Beartown;__Book_1: Beartown's last ember of hope lies in the success of its youth hockey league. When a scandal breaks involving the star player and the manager's daughter, each town member must choose whether they're on the side of justice, or the dream of a chance at finally winning.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Blue_Highways;_The_Travel_Tr: William set off on what would become a 13,000 mile journey by van, visiting the most overlooked small towns in America. His series of travel memoirs prove that it's not where you go, it's who you meet! Blue highways are back roads.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Maybe_You_Should_Talk_to_Som: Lori Gottlieb is a therapist who needs therapy. As she tells the stories of her (nameless) patients, she recognises themes in common with her own self-talk. A funny and hopeful memoir about our shared desires and capacity for change.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_I_Capture_the_Castle: Seventeen year-old Cassandra lives in the remnants of a castle with her eccentric family. Her 1934 journal is going strong, but her father's latest book is a work-in-procrastination, so money is tight. Maybe romance and a strategic prank can change their fates!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Interior_Chinatown: Willis has the opposite of main character energy. But whenever he walks into the Golden Palace restaurant, he's on the set of Black and White, a cop show that's somehow always in production. This novel is a creative look at cultural tropes and Asian stereotypes.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Warcross;_Book_1: Emika Chen is a hacker paid to track players making illegal bets inside the Warcross game. When she glitches into the game herself for some extra cash, the game's creator, Hideo Tanaka, decides she'll make the perfect spy. An immersive YA series!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Moonwalking_with_Einstein;Th: Journalist Joshua Foer spent a year training to improve his memory with the world's top experts, eventually entering–and winning!–the US Memory Competition. This book will teach you how he did it, so you can remember what this book was about!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Women_Travel_Solo;30_Inspiri: Solo travel can be intimidating! This anthology will encourage you to book that trip. Read about the experiences and personal revelations of 30 female solo travelers, complete with scenic photographs to encourage your wanderlust.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Baking_with_Kim-Joy;Cute_and: 40 recipes from the sunshine-filled Great British Bake Off finalist. If your desserts don't make your friends squeal with delight, are they even treats? This cookbook includes colourful instructions for making llama cookies, panda-madeleines, and choux bun turtles.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Brown_Girl_Dreaming: An award-winning memoir-in-verse. Jacqueline uses poetry to share what it was like growing up Black during the 1960s-1970s in South Carolina and New York, including the growing joy she found in writing. A powerful, yet approachable book for middle-grade readers.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Sir_Gawain_and_the_Green_Kni: In this epic 14th-century poem, a green knight on a green horse (do they eat green eggs and ham?) arrives at Camelot on Yuletide. He throws his glove, an open challenge to King Arthur's knights. Sir Gawain accepts the wager, but he has no clue what he’s in for!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_I_Know_Why_the_Caged_Bird_Si: Maya's childhood was one of prejudice, neglect, and violence. Adult Maya finds the keys to her cage of trauma through self-love, escaping to the embrace of good books and kind people. A tragic and inspiring autobiography from a resilient Black poet.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Woman_in_Cabin_10;Lo_Bla: A week on an über luxury yacht? Yes, please. Travel journalist Lo witnesses a woman thrown overboard, but frustratingly, no one believes she's telling the truth. A suspenseful thriller with a cast of characters that rivals Agatha Christie!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Complete_Father_Brown: Father Brown is an English crime-solving priest with a sympathetic ear and sharp insight into human nature. This collection comprises 49 cases featuring the beloved cassock-wearing, bicycle-riding detective in the fictional village of Kembleford.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_If_Beale_Street_Could_Talk: Tish and Fonny are engaged and expecting a child, when Fonny is jailed for a crime he didn't commit. Their families band together to try to clear his name. An emotionally devastating love story about racial prejudice and criminal injustice.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Mend!;A_Refashioning_Manual_: Decrease the number of clothes you toss, and learn how to repair them in ways that make them a work of art! A how-to guide explaining the process and possibilities of mending, perfect for the experienced sewist or the person who’s never picked up a needle.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Our_Town: This Pulitzer Prize-winning play is about the tragic beauty of life's journey, as seen through the residents of Grover's Corners, a fictional town in 1930s New Hampshire.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Long_Way_to_a_Small,_Ang: In this queer space opera, a rag-tag team of travellers take a dangerous job tunnelling a wormhole to a distant planet. The commission of a lifetime might not pay off, but the found-family in this sci-fi series sure does!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Room: Five-year-old Jack's entire world is confined to a single room with his mother. She created a plan to escape their mysterious prison, but Jack will need to follow it exactly for it to work. An emotional thriller told through the voice of a young child.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Three-Body_Problem;Remem: Scientists disappear after entering a virtual reality 'game'. The military set an outgoing message of peace to other planets, but a woman familiar with violence corrected the broadcast. The first book in a dramatic Hugo Award-winning series from author Cixin Liu.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Death_of_a_Salesman;Certain_: It's 1940 and Willy Loman is as fatally insecure as his career. This depressing play asks whether the pursuit of the consumerist American dream is really all it's cracked up to be.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Man_for_All_Seasons: This biographical dramatisation follows the escalating conflict between Lord Chancellor Sir Thomas More and Henry VIII from 1529 to 1535. As Henry pushes political and religious buttons, More pushes back. A historical play that will leave you wanting more.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Hard_Times: Meet Bouderby and Gradgrind, two men of industry. Their flawed views on life are evident in the outlooks of three children: Louisa, Thomas, and Cecilia. A comedic romance set amid the smoggy circus of mid-19th-century industrial society.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Lessons_in_Chemistry: Elizabeth Zott is a brilliant chemist. But it's the 1950s, so men are constantly shutting doors in her face. A TV producer needs a host for a new cooking show. Cooking is chemistry, after all. A feminist historical fiction with a sad love story, equal parts infuriating and inspiring!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Salt,_Fat,_Acid,_Heat;Master: To learn cooking, you must first master the four elements... Samin Nosrat has taught chefs of all ages and stages how to perfect the flavour, balance, and texture of food using salt, fat, acid, and heat. Includes 150 illustrations + infographics to guide your culinary journey!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Walden: Ever wanted to walk away from civilisation, into the woods, and owe nothing to anyone but yourself? You'll find a friend in Henry David Thoreau. His record of simple living and contemplation of civil disobedience will fascinate nature-lovers and deep thinkers alike.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Comfort_Book_: Matt saved all the little pieces of encouragement that kept him going, and put them in this book. This self-help book is an invitation to reflect and rebuild your hope. Take what you need!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Crying_in_H_Mart: A heartfelt memoir from the artist behind Japanese Breakfast. Michelle writes about how grief sent her back to her Korean heritage for grounding and comfort, including the dishes she used to share with her mother.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_True_Grit: It's 1878, and fourteen-year-old Mattie wants vengeance. Tom Chaney took her father's life, his horse, and $150 in cash. Mattie convinces Rooster Cogburn, the toughest U.S. Marshal in the west, to accompany her in a manhunt across Indian territory.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_How_of_Happiness;A_Scien: An easy guide for finding and feeling happy! Learn the scientific research behind sustaining happiness, and make it personal with quizzes and exercises to explore where and how you experience joy.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Pink_Eraser_Art;The_Ultimate: Learn how to make tiny block prints using an overlooked school supply–pink erasers! Artist Serena Rios McRae tells readers everything they need to get started, including where to find inspiration, in this step-by-step guide.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Evelina: Evelina is a naive young woman who learns firsthand about the dangers of fashionable society. A sharply comedic painting of excess, love, and women's status in eighteenth-century London. A novel from one of Jane Austen's favourite authors!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Dickens_at_Christmas: Bah! Humbug! A collection of Dickens' famous Christmas tales, both heartwarming and spooky. This edition includes A Christmas Carol, The Chimes, A Cricket on the Hearth, Battle of Life, and the Haunted Man.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_House_of_Many_Ways;(The_Movi: Charmain agreed to house sit. Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Caturday_in_Bookstonbury;_Vo: In this visual photographic history of Bookstonbury, Luna Knight documents the local feline population. From majestic longhairs to playful shorthairs and everything in between, take a gander and learn more about these adorable floofs.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Master_of_Djinn: In an alternate 1920s steampunk world where djinn magic has redefined Cairo society, witty and stylish Agent Fatma must investigate a supernatural murder with the help of her mysterious girlfriend, Siti.

Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Working_Songs_of_Bookstonbur: A collection of traditional shanties and sea songs by sailors and dockworkers around Bookstonbury harbour. Contains some old classics, as well as lesser-known local songs like The Net-Eating Shark and Even The Seagulls Like A Good Book.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Madeline: Follow the adventures of 7-year-old Madeline in this illustrated children's book set in picturesque Paris. Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Merry_Mister_Meddle;_Mister_: A collection of humorous tales about Mister Meddle and his disastrous attempts at being helpful; like putting a 'growing-spell' in a wash-tub to help with laundry or mistaking glue for treacle that he uses to spruce up his aunt's pudding!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Fish_Out_of_Water: There must be a reason why we've always been told to feed our pets just a little and "not too much".
