Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Island_of_the_Blue_Dolphins: This timeless children's classic is based on the true story of a young Nicoleño girl stranded on an island for 18 years. Alone, Karana learns to survive the elements, and forges an unexpected bond with the wild animals she once feared and hunted.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Tuesdays_with_Morrie: Over many meaningful conversations made during many Tuesday visits, the author reconnects with his dying college professor, Morrie. This short-but-moving memoir reflects on life's greatest questions.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Girl_Who_Fell_Beneath_th: Inspired by a Korean folktale, this story follows Mina, a young girl who travels to the magical Spirit Realm and discovers the Sea God is in an enchanted sleep. With the help of the mysterious Shin, can Mina reawaken the slumbering god and save her village?
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Five_People_You_Meet_in_: After sacrificing his life to save a child in a tragic accident, old war veteran Eddie embarks on an afterlife journey where he meets the five people who shaped his life, and learns that his life was not as hollow and uninspired as he had once believed.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Secret_Island;_The_Secre: A cosy tale of four children, Mike, Peggy, Nora and their friend Jack, who escape to a "secret" island on a serene lake, where they live an unfettered life of stowing away in a willow-treehouse and foraging for their own food.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_I_See_You: Zoe's photo is in the paper. A mistake, or perhaps a message? Consumed by paranoia, she and Detective Kelly race to uncover the truth. Someone is watching... Waiting... And danger seems to lurk in every corner.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Toymakers: The Emporium is where Papa Jack and his two sons craft and sell magical toys for children every winter's frost. Set in 1940s London, Cathy, young and homeless, is welcomed into the fold of the toyshop, where she learns to understand the magic of childhood imagination.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Night_Circus: A tale of the competition between two young magicians, where they duel using the breathtaking wonders of a magical circus they create together. Though only one can be left standing by the end, Celia and Marco are magnetically drawn together in a tragic love.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_William: In his high-tech home, Henry, a brilliant engineer, has created an artificially intelligent consciousness —William. However, William goes rogue when some guests visit, leading to a cat-and-mouse game of survival where the house itself becomes the danger.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Heartless: Not all fairytales have a happy ending. The Queen of Hearts is a brutal monarch. But once, she was just Catherine—young and idealistic. Shenanigans ensue when Cath meets Jest, sparking a forbidden love story where hearts are stolen, broken and freely given...
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Sunlit_Man: Nomad has been jumping between different worlds to stay ahead of his pursuers. But with his diminished powers, he is trapped on a planet where the sun's intensity will kill, and finds himself caught up in a struggle between a despotic ruler and the defiant rebels.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Chalk_Man: In 1986, Eddie and his friends used chalk figures as a secret code—until it led them to a body. Now in 2016, these menacing figures have returned, and another murder ensues. Eddie must return to the past to uncover seething secrets and unearth the killer's identity.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Taking_of_Annie_Thorne: Joe Thorne has never gotten over his sister's disappearance and her unsettling return. As Stephen King says (and surely Joe would agree), “sometimes, dead is better". Now he's home, back where it all went wrong, seeking answers and revenge as he confronts the past.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Don't_Be_Silly,_Mr_Twiddle!;: Mr Twiddle is a kind and honest fellow but he is often forgetful, lazy and very, very, VERY silly! This is a collection of his hilarious misadventures, and the many muddles he gets himself—and poor Mrs Twiddle—into.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Yumi_and_the_Nightmare_Paint: Yumi, hailing from a life of spirituality, and Painter, who lives in darkness, technology and nightmares, find themselves interchanging lives periodically. To uncover this mystery—and stop an impending disaster—they must work together and learn to understand each other.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Deadly_Diseases;Horrible_Sci: Filled with sick jokes, sickening stories and seriously sick facts, discover all the dreadful details of deadly diseases that mankind has suffered through!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Disgusting_Digestion;Horribl: Get ready for a new dose of Horrible Science! Pack your lunchboxes for we're going on a journey through your stinky, smelly, and gooey digestive system to uncover foul secrets you'd never learn in class.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Nasty_Nature;Horrible_Scienc: All about the nastiest things nature has to offer! From freaky deep-sea creatures to pesky sky-borne parasites, you're bound to become a true naturalist by the final page.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Secret_History: Richard reminisces his time at an elitist college, in his throes of unrequited obsession for a clique of unabashed intellectuals and ditzy decadents. He yearns to befriend them, sleep with them, become them—including, as they indulge in ever-spiraling hedonism, murder.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Life_of_Pi: Imagine young Robinson Crusoe, but his island is a solitary lifeboat teeming with wild animals—including a huge Bengal tiger. Pi's journey is one marked by persistent uncertainty and fantastical encounters, where survival is intertwined with sublime wonder and faith.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Chemical_Chaos;Horrible_Scie: Chemistry is confusing, and chemistry lessons are boring. Fret not! For this book is not about the bits you learn in school—but the funny bits, the fascinating bits and the bits that end up in blasts and bangs and dodgy discoveries!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Insurgent;Divergent_#2: As war looms over the five fractured factions, Tris must now embrace her Divergence and choose a side in a conflict where every choice comes with a devastating cost. Book two of the dystopian trilogy Divergent.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Allegiant;Divergent_#3: As the Factionless seize power, a new civil war threatens to destroy what remains of the shattered faction society. Tris, Four, and a handful of allies must venture beyond the barriers to save their city from self-destruction. How is the war going to end? And when?
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Star_Wars:_Lost_Stars: Thane Kyrell and Ciena Ree are childhood friends-turned-lovers with different upbringings. When a disillusioned Thane defects to the Rebellion, Ciena is forced to choose between an Empire undeserving of her loyalty and the man she loves in a galaxy-wide war.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Eileen: Set in the early 60s, this book chronicles Eileen's budding friendship with the charismatic Rebecca Saint John—and the obsessive affection that pulls her complicit into a crime. A character-driven tale for lovers of unreliable narrators and a dash of dark humour.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Little_Hope: A collection of short stories about different intertwined characters in a small town. Each story is filled with heartbreak, grief and love as the characters battle with the past, try to manage the present and worry about their future.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_On_Earth_We're_Briefly_Gorge: A novel written in the form of a letter, addressed from a son to his illiterate mother; a recipient who, like a ghost, is not promised—only longed for. Redolent of queer and feminist thinking, this is a raw and earnest exploration of race, class, and honesty.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Giver;(Book_1): Jonas lives in a perfectly perfect world. But when he is chosen as the Receiver—the sole keeper of humanity's suppressed memories from long since past—he uncovers the startling realities upon which his society is built.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Gathering_Blue;(The_Giver,_B: Set in a post-apocalyptic world where the 'undesirable' are cast out, orphaned and disabled Kira is spared for her magical embroidery. Forced to work for the village, she begins unraveling the dark truths hidden beneath its innocent facade.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Messenger;(The_Giver,_Book_3: In a Village now consumed by avarice and fear, and a Forest that has turned lethal, Matty the Messenger boy must make a final, dangerous journey. The acclaimed Giver quartet continues with another poignant dystopian parable.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_How_to_Train_a_Superdog: Unlock secrets to your dog's mind! This handy-dandy little book, complete with a training program and helpful illustrations, will guide you to unleashing your pet's true potential and raising them to be the best-est of best pooch!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Conversations_with_Friends: This novel follows Frances as she navigates the complex relationships with her best friend and ex-girlfriend, Bobbi, and an older married couple, Nick and Melissa. A piercing exploration of blurred boundaries of intimacy and the struggles of one's identity.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Son;(The_Giver,_Book_4): A spellbinding conclusion to the Giver quartet, this story follows Claire, who is assigned the role of a Vessel—a birthmother tasked with carrying a Product to term. A tale of a mother who will stop at nothing to find and reconnect with the son taken from her.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Terrifying_Tudors;Horrible_H: History can be horrible, and it was the vicious people of the past who made it that way. Fascinatingly, some of these terrible people all had names beginning with 'T'... Like the teachers—I mean, the Tudors!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Barmy_British_Empire;Horribl: History of the British Empire is full of horrible people and horrible deeds. Find out how a war started when a Brit was sitting on a stool and who wore a necklace made of human skulls in this not-so-horribly-boring history book!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Villainous_Victorians;Horrib: Teachers may tell you Victoria's Britain was an exciting place, but it was also a time of cruelty and wickedness. Read on for all the vile facts about the villainous Victorians, peppered with horribly hilarious humour that will keep you turning pages!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Will_You_Love_Me?;The_story_: In this two-part fostering memoir, Cathy Glass shares the story of Lucy's journey, told from the perspectives of both her birth mother and foster mother, revealing how their lives became intertwined.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Saving_Danny: One of Cathy Glass's many fostering memoirs, this is the story of Danny, who comes into her care when his parents can no longer cope with his learning difficulties. It's a powerful testament to how a little love and patience can change a child's life.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Steelheart;The_Reckoners_#1: Absolute power corrupts absolutely, and in a world where superpowers create inhuman despots, David seeks revenge on the strongest of them all: Steelheart—the one deemed invincible, but the one he's seen bleed. Get ready for an action-packed sci-fi adventure!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Girl_who_Rowed_the_Ocean: Lucy wants to go on a real adventure, so she rows across the Atlantic! Along the way, she faces storms, seasickness, and gigantic sea creatures, but also magical sunsets, dolphins, and shooting stars. A tale for little dreamers who long to see the wonders of the world.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Journey_into_the_Mind's_Eye;: A collection of anecdotes chronicling a woman's journey to Siberia to find a lover from her youth—the man who once enchanted her with Russian fairytales. An ode to pre-revolutionary Russia and the author's metaphorical seduction by old, vanished Russia.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Sea_Inside: A collection of anecdotes, histories, and mythologies from Philip's seemingly aimless wanderings across the world—each one, in its own way, connected to the sea, its islands, and its maritime creatures.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_British_Boutique_Hotels: From quiet country retreats to luxurious city stays, this pocket-sized guide is your key to Britain's best boutique hotels! A highly opinionated and indispensable companion for the discerning traveler.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Wilder_Shores_of_Love: An engaging account of four women from the nineteenth century who threw off their corsets and escaped their boring, conventional lives to find love and adventure on the wilder shores of the Middle East.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Coffee_First,_Then_the_World: We've all been on a bike, maybe even done a few long-distance ride. But Jenny Graham took it much further: she cycled around the world! This is her raw, unfiltered, and hilarious account of how she became the fastest woman to ever circumnavigate the globe on two wheels.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Florence_Diary: A charming diary, chronicling Athill's fortnight in Italy, 1947. Illustrated with delightful black and white photos of Florence, this little book captures an era of travel that has been lost to time.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Boundless_Sea;A_Human_Hi: In this dauntingly comprehensive volume, explore humankind's relationship with the planet's greatest body of water—the ocean. This definitive work chronicles the world history of maritime empires and trade routes, while debunking long-held myths and beliefs.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_the_sun_and_her_flowers: A collection of poetry that takes us on a transcendent journey through five chapters of love, growth, and healing while weaving in the shared experiences of immigration and the refugee passage.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Edinburgh;_Picturesque_Notes: A travelogue told in a series of anecdotes with whimsical exaggerations that captures the author's view of his hometown circa late 1870s, in all its glories and infamies.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Nutmeg_Trail;A_Culinary_: From the spice route map to its magical flavour profiles, from the culinary history to its recipes, this is a book to inhale, to savour, and to return to again and again!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Garden_of_Evening_Mists: Set in post-war Malaya, this story follows Yun Ling, a war-crime survivor and retired judge, through a shifting timeline between the 1980s and flashbacks to 1949, as she seeks solace in the lush highlands of her childhood.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Man_Called_Ove: Featuring Ove, the quintessential curmudgeon and a ragtag cast of characters, this is the tale of how healing can occur with the unlikeliest of people, in the unlikeliest of ways.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Monster_Calls: Conor is haunted by monsters—his mother's illness, his father's absence, school bullies, and teachers' pity. Then, one night, a real monster visits. And it has come for one purpose: to tell Conor three stories in exchange for the truth.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Lost_Words;A_Spell_Book: Gone are the days when children’s alphabets began with A for Acorn, B for Butterfly and C for Caterpillar. But in this book of spellbinding poetry and enchanting illustrations, the magical words of nature, travel, and animals are restored into our lives.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Tomb_with_a_View;The_Stori: Uncovering the histories of those lying in a place where time stands still, Peter Ross pays homage to the famous, the infamous, and the forgotten in graveyards across Britain and Ireland. A book for all the taphophiles out there!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Buzz_in_the_Meadows;The_Na: A tale of how Goulson transformed a derelict farm into a sanctuary for plants and pollinators. Filled with humorous anecdotes and fascinating science, this book is a heartfelt plea to cherish and protect life in all its forms—especially the tiniest of creatures.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Letters_from_Egypt;1862-1869: After her diagnosis of tuberculosis, Lady Gordon travels to Egypt in hopes of improving her dwindling health. A compilation of her letters, detailing her account of life in Luxor, this is the story of an Englishwoman's immersion into Egyptian culture.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_I_Am_Number_Four;Lorien_Lega: Four is one of nine survivors from a race of super-powered aliens hiding on Earth. He doesn't know where the others are, only that they are being hunted by their enemies in numerical order. The first three are gone. Four is next.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Journey;Big_Panda_and_Ti: The adventures of Big Panda and Tiny Dragon continue as they navigate some of life's trying moments. Accompanied by charming illustrations, this is a beautiful picture book about friendship and overcoming adversity.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Provence_to_Pondicherry;Reci: Starting in Provence and following the routes of early French explorers, Kiros takes us on a journey to discover French culinary influences in far-flung colonial destinations through an array of delicious recipes.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Dragon_Apparent;Travels_in: In the final decade before war would sweep all he witnessed into history, Lewis travels through Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia to see the curtain start to fall on an era of French colonial rule.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_My_Tiny_Atlas;Our_World_Thro: A collection of photographs of picturesque wonders from all around the globe. The perfect companion for the avid traveler or the armchair dreamer with a serious case of wanderlust!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Ginger_Tree: Set in the early 1900s, we follow Mary as she sails across the world to marry a man she barely knows. But when a forbidden love affair costs her everything, she must forge a completely new life from scratch.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Round_the_World_in_Eighty_Di: A rich collection of dishes from around the world, each accompanied by its own travel anecdote that opens a fascinating window into a time long past.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Pictures_from_Italy: Did you know Charles Dickens wrote travelogues? A vivid account of his sojourn in Italy, with a thrilling blend of personal excitement and piercing social commentary on a land that both charmed and provoked him.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Shearwater;A_Bird,_an_Ocean,: Intertwining memoir, nature writing, and travelogue, this book chronicles the author's year-long adventure in pursuit of the longstanding object of his fascination: the impressive seabird known as the Manx shearwater, or Puffinus puffinus!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Travel_Light,_Move_Fast: Told through a series of juxtaposed vignettes from her past, this memoir by Alexandra pieces together the portrait of a fascinating, roughly-hewn, and ultimately tragic family and their misadventures of in southern and central Africa.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_An_Atlas_of_Countries_that_D: From vast regions like Catalonia to tiny islands claimed by a single person, this book tours 50 unrecognised and largely unnoticed 'countries'—by turns hilarious, heartbreaking, and fascinating. The perfect bunny-slipper read for the armchair traveler.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Voyage_for_Madmen: Nine men. One race to sail across the world. One to win the prestige, glamour and trophy; the rest to fall to madness, failure, and death. The thrilling accounts from the contestants of the Golden Globe race of 1968.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Skyward;(Book_1): Humanity is trapped on a planet under attack by mysterious aliens. Spensa, living among them, dreams of joining the pilots defending humanity. Join her, as she fights for a place in flight school and faces the harsh reality of war.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Starsight;(Skyward,_Book_2): In this sequel to Skyward, Spensa, ace pilot, now has more questions left unanswered. Why do the aliens keep attacking humanity? Why could she hear the stars scream? With nothing but a bold plan, Spensa risks it all to discover the truth, or die trying.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Bright_Sword: The adventure of Collum and the oddballs of the Round Table as they seek to restore order to the kingdom after the death of King Arthur and the heroes of legend. Together, they will learn the troubled past of King Arthur and mysteries of Britain.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Invisible_Life_of_Addie_: Addie Larue once made a deal with the devil. Now she wanders the world as a ghost, forgotten by everyone she meets. Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Saviour_Fish;Life_and_De: A captivating blend of travel writing and environmental reportage, this erudite work chronicles the author's life on remote Ukerewe Island in Lake Victoria, offering a profound perspective on ecological and cultural upheaval.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_A_Darker_Shade_of_Magic;Shad: Set in multiple Londons (yes, you read that right!), with cross-dressing thieves, aspiring pirates, and sadistic kings, prepare yourself for a thrilling trilogy brimming with magic, lots of magic, more magic... and angst!
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Hunting_Mister_Heartbreak;A_: A travelogue; a social history; a love letter to the United States. Written in the wondrous, wry prose of an adventurer and a scholar, this work offers an outsider's keen eye on America's inconsistencies, foibles, and grandeur.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Time_Keeper: A story of slowing down and treasuring every moment, where Father Time comes to our world, one consumed by counting every second and minute, to teach two individuals about the gift of life and the beauty of its conclusion.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Foundryside;The_Founders_Tri: Sancia Grado is a good thief with some...unique abilities. In her latest heist, Sancia unknowingly steals an ancient artifact that could shake the foundations of the universe. In the city of Tevanne, the Merchant Houses are king. And now, they hunt Sancia.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Ashfall_Legacy;Ashfall_#1: Syd Chambers, alien-human hybrid, has never known his father, a Denza native who disappeared years ago. Picking up the trail, Syd now journeys beyond Earth to seek out his father, discovering a universe-shattering secret along the way.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Rhythm_of_the_Rain: With a gentle tip of his jar, a boy sends droplets of water on a long journey downstream. This gorgeous picture book follows that journey, gently tracing the path of the water cycle.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_The_Door-to-Door_Bookstore: A tender story of an old bookseller, who delivers personalised selections to his customers, and the unlikely friendship with a little girl that changes his life forever... A book about books, for every book lovers and bibliophiles out there.
Loca_Base Books EN.Description_Supernova;Renegades_#3: The Renegades' greatest enemy is alive, a danger once more to Gatlon City. In this thrilling conclusion to the Renegades, Adrian and Nova struggle to protect those they love, all while keeping secrets from one another. When the dust settles, who will be left standing?

Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Crime03_Completed: Phew. Crisis averted. The new watchtower you funded with a contribution of $total <sprite name="MoneyIcon" tint=0> is appeasing parents' worries.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Monster_Active: Follow up on reports of a mysterious monster hiding at the beach, and find out what's behind those curious screams.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Monster_Completed: You followed up on reports of a mysterious monster hiding at the beach and found out that it's a seal!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Seashells_Active: Harper is studying seashells at the beach. Help her by collecting shells while you have the Marine Biology Device equipped.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Seashells_CO: Harper needs to examine these $total species very closely.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Seashells_Completed: You documented the seashell varieties of Bookstonbury. The scientific community thanks you for your service.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Castles01_Active: No better place to dream yourself away than Bookston Bay. Sell the fantasy $total times during the summer holidays!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Castles01_Active_Short: Sell <nobr>$total <sprite name="FantasyIcon" tint=0 color=$FantasyColor> Fantasy</nobr> at the Beach
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Castles01_CO: See what Harper thinks about your Fantasy sales at the Beach during Summer.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Castles01_Completed: You sold $total books from your fantasy selection. Looks like it has gathered quite a few adventurers at the beach.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Castles02_Active: The sandcastle architects need your help! Fund their constructions with a grant of $total <sprite name="MoneyIcon" tint=0>.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Castles02_Active_Short: Gather <nobr>$total <sprite name="MoneyIcon" tint=0></nobr> for Beach gear
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Castles02_CO: Harper needs that money for equipment! Better deliver it while it's still summer.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Castles02_Completed: Whoa! These sandcastles are taking on epic proportions thanks to your $total <sprite name="MoneyIcon" tint=0> contribution! Let's see what Harper has to say.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Castles03_Active: Gather your army! Uhh, I mean... Gather some help for those sandcastles. Sell $total fantasy in a day during Summer.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Castles03_Active_Short: Sell <nobr>$total <sprite name="FantasyIcon" tint=0 color=$FantasyColor> Fantasy</nobr> in a day
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Castles03_CO: Check back at the beach in the Summer to see how our sand architects have gotten along.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Beach_Castles03_Completed: Today, a new a empire was born. A sand empire! A Sandpire!
Loca_Base Texts EN.SandcastleArchitect_CD: Harper's sandcastle designs rival those of the greats! But she will find a new obsession soon, certainly.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_AhoyMatey_Active: Introduce yourself to Walt the Sailor. He's usually sitting by the stairs at the waterfront.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_AhoyMatey_Active_Short: Introduce yourself to Walt the Sailor
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_AhoyMatey_Completed: You made the acquaintance of Walt the Sailor.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_ShowOffYourCatch_Active: Introduce the locals to your literary selection. Sell $total books to sailors.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_ShowOffYourCatch_Active_Short: Sell <nobr>$total books</nobr> to the local sailors
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_ShowOffYourCatch_Completed: You totally won that bet against Walt! Let's see if you've managed to impress him.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_ShowOffYourCatch_CD: Impressive catch yer got there, arrrrrr! – Walt, probably
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_ShipHappens_Active: Your bookshop needs to be seaworthy to get invited to the fishmarket.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_ShipHappens_CO: Show off your maritime chic to Walt at the waterfront.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_ShipHappens_Completed: The sailors are happy with your decorations, and decide not to sink your ship... this time.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_AdoptDog_D: The little stray seems to want to stay with you. You could adopt him!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_FeedDog_D: That stray you met seems really hungry. Why don't you throw him a bone or something?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_FeedDog_CD: He seems to really like fish! And you, apparently.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_ScareAwayContinenta_AD: The Continenta has claimed our shores and polluted our waters. How can we make the waterfront worse and scare away those tourists?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_ScareAwayContinenta_SD: Get rid of the cruise ship tourists at the Waterfront
Loca_Base Texts EN.Waterfront_ScareAwayContinenta_CD: Your seagull minions have fought valiantly by your side. The tourists are gone.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Walt_ClearShop_CO: Hey, nice shopping! Come back soon for Walt's grand opening.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Walt_ClearShop_AD: Walt has decided to clear out his old fisher's shed. Can you take these last items off his hands?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Walt_ClearShop_CD: Trinkets 'n' Treasures is up and running! Not in small part due to your patronage.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Walt_ShopMemory_AD: Walt has finally decided to turn trinket sales into his main gig, and he needs your help.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Walt_ShopMemory_SD: Help Walt open a new shop
Loca_Base Texts EN.Walt_ShopMemory_CD: The sailors and fishers have found a new haven: Walt's stall welcomes all.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Walt_PromoteShop_SD: Sell <nobr>$total books</nobr> in a day at the Waterfront
Loca_Base Texts EN.Walt_PromoteShop_AD: Attract customers to Walt's new shop with a cool cross-promotion deal.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Walt_PromoteShop_CO: Look at all those customers! Let's give the good news to Walt.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Walt_PromoteShop_CD: Thanks to your help, Walt's new shop is a booming success.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Inspire_Walt_Stories_AD: In all those years on the sea, Walt has seen a lot. Help him tell his stories.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Inspire_Walt_Stories_CD: Are all these stories really true? Well, I wouldn't put it past Walt.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Cafe01_Active: Tilde asked you to meet her at the café in town. Seems like she won't accept no for an answer.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Cafe01_Active_Short: Go to the Café and speak to Tilde
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Cafe01_Completed: You rolled up to the café, as Tilde requested.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_TildeIsMoving01_Active: Check by Tilde's old bookshop and pick up all five of her moving boxes outside.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_TildeIsMoving01_Active_Short: Pick up all of Tilde's items at the Café
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_TildeIsMoving01_Completed: You've loaded some mysterious boxes into your wagon. Now you're supposed to deliver them to Tilde.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_TildeIsMoving02_Active: Bring Tilde's old stuff with you to the Flea Market on Saturday. She might finally be satisfied after that.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_TildeIsMoving02_Active_Short: Have Tilde's Stuff equipped at the Flea Market
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_TildeIsMoving02_Completed: You delivered Tilde's old bookshop furniture to the flea market. She's offering them at a reasonable price.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam01_Active: Do you truly know what your customers want?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam01_Active_Short: Give $total successful recommendations at the Café
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam01_CO: Maryam will surely tell you how you did.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam01_Completed: Your recommendations are truly unparalleled, and you showed a mastery of your craft.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam02_Active: Decorate your bookshop to appeal to the classy clientele at the café.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam02_Active_Short: Equip $total <nobr><sprite name="UI_Classy" tint=0> classy</nobr> decor items
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam02_Completed: Wow, your tastes are exquisite! This decor elevates the book-buying experience.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam03_Active: Can your business survive even the hardest of times? Maryam has left out her rubbish bins to prove a point.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam03_Active_Short: Sell <nobr>$total books</nobr> in a day with Maryam's bins around
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam03_Completed: You've managed to stay afloat, even amid the rubbish. But that smell might haunt you.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam04_Active: Maintain a sales streak of $total consecutive days at the café, selling at least 5 books each day.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam04_Active_Short: Maintain a sales streak at the Café
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam04_Completed: Wow, you're on a real hot streak! Your sales are through the roof!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam05_D: Show variety by selling one book of $total different genres in a day at the café.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam05_SD: Sell a book from $total different genres in one day
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam05_CD: Impressive! How did you manage to sell so many different genres at the café?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam06_D: Can you prove your perceptiveness to Maryam? Try to answer all of her questions correctly.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_Maryam06_CD: Wow, you really do pay attention! Does this mean you're reading this text right now? Cool! Hi!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_AttendFFF_AD: Can your bookshop strike fear into the hearts of your visitors at Fall Fear Fest?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_AttendFFF_SD: Attend the Fear Fest with a <nobr><sprite name="UI_Spooky" tint=0> spooky</nobr> setup
Loca_Base Texts EN.Cafe_AttendFFF_CD: Not a single spirit has dared to haunt your bookshop.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_ResearchProject_AD: Anne needs your help with her dissertation. Can you help her plants grow?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_ResearchProject_SD: Equip the research plants until they're grown
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_ResearchProject_CO: Tell Anne about her plants' progress!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_ResearchProject_CD: You helped create some freaky mutations. Seems like they like being around books...
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Plant01_AD: Equip Anne's strange seedling at inner-city locations, away from the sea, until it's fully grown.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Plant01_SD: Equip the plant at inner-city locations
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Plant01_CO: The seed has grown into a creepy plant! Let's see what Anne can tell you about it.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Plant01_CD: Wow, this creepy plant has a job! It eats invasive slugs around Bookstonbury!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Plant02_SD: Equip the plant on rainy days
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Plant02_AD: Leave Anne's newest seedling outside in the rain until it's fully grown!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Plant02_CO: The seed has grown into a cute plant! Let's see what Anne can tell you about it.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Plant02_CD: How is the bleeding heart still blooming? Quite dramatic.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Plant03_AD: Equip this last seedling as you visit Bookstonbury's coastal locations.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Plant03_SD: Equip the plant at coastal locations
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Plant03_CO: The seed has grown into a magical plant! Let's see what Anne can tell you about it.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Plant03_CD: In antiquity, wolfsbane was used as a poison. Now, it could be used to heal!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Graduation_AD: Anne wants you there when she is completing this important life chapter.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Graduation_CO: Anne will come by to talk to you soon.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Anne_Graduation_CD: If you ever need advice, just ask your friend, the Master of Science!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Klaus_Inspire_AD: Want to help Klaus come up with a song? Try recommending books he likes and talking to him often.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Klaus_Inspire_SD: Talk to Klaus until he feels inspired
Loca_Base Texts EN.Klaus_Inspire_CO: Do you think Klaus had an idea yet?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Klaus_Inspire_CD: Walk those hollow halls of history? Oh hell yeah, I didn't know historical books could be so metal.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Make_the_Concert_Happen_AD: Silens Libri is planning their first-ever concert! But Klaus needs help. Can you help the band find an audience and a place to play?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Make_the_Concert_Happen_SD: Help Klaus's band find an audience and a stage
Loca_Base Texts EN.Make_the_Concert_Happen_CO: When will Klaus finally play that concert? Let's hope he doesn't get cold feet.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Make_the_Concert_Happen_CD: Silens Libri is ready for their first-ever concert, mostly thanks to your efforts!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Find_an_Audience_AD: Looks like Klaus's band is too underground. Show their poster to local metal fans.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Find_an_Audience_SD: Promote Silens Libri using Klaus's poster
Loca_Base Texts EN.Find_an_Audience_CO: Let's see if Klaus likes the theatre stage for their performance.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Find_an_Audience_CD: Klaus is over the moon! $total people have already signed up for Silens Libri's newsletter. Big things can happen now.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Find_a_Stage_AD: Turns out there's no eligible stage... yet. But wouldn't there be space near the lighthouse?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Find_a_Stage_SD: Find Klaus a stage for his band
Loca_Base Texts EN.Find_a_Stage_CO: Tell Klaus about the stage at the lighthouse.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Find_a_Stage_CD: Now that's what I call a stage! Rock on!
Loca_Base Texts EN.AttendConcert_Active: Cheer on Silens Libri on Thursday at the lighthouse (and maybe start a mosh pit).
Loca_Base Texts EN.AttendConcert_Completed: Yo, this was so metal! My ears are ringing now, but wow!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Van_Part_01_AD: Klaus needs a carbonated incinerator... whatever that may be.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Van_Part_01_CD: You got Klaus a carbonated incinerator. What could it be for?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Van_Part_02_AD: Find Klaus a washer-proof shifter. It sounds essential!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Van_Part_02_CD: You found Klaus a washer-proof shifter. Is he making these up?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Van_Part_03_AD: Find Klaus an iodine-plated fuel duct, because how can his van run without one?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Van_Part_03_SD: Get Klaus an iodine-plated fuel duct
Loca_Base Texts EN.Van_Part_03_CD: You found Klaus an iodine-plated fuel duct.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Repair_the_Van_AD: Klaus is trying his best to fix this oxidised metal pile, formerly known as a van, into something resembling a tour bus. Can you help him?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Repair_the_Van_SD: Help Klaus repair the tour bus
Loca_Base Texts EN.Repair_the_Van_CD: Look at that, who would have thought any part of this vehicle still works?
Loca_Base Texts EN.GoodbyeKlaus_Active: Klaus is saying his farewells at the waterfront. You don't want to miss it, right?
Loca_Base Texts EN.GoodbyeKlaus_Completed: Let's hope this doesn't go to his head! See you Klaus...
Loca_Base Texts EN.MysteriousNoises_AD: Mysterious and frankly unsettling noises have been heard from the sea caves. We must get to the bottom of this!
Loca_Base Texts EN.MysteriousNoises_SD: Investigate the noises coming from the sea caves
Loca_Base Texts EN.MysteriousNoises_CD: Guess it wasn't a dinosaur after all!
Loca_Base Texts EN.StBookstonMystery_AD: Who was St. Bookston really? And where do the strange fragments lead to? A case bound to reshape Bookstonbury's history!
Loca_Base Texts EN.StBookstonMystery_SD: Investigate the history of St. Bookston
Loca_Base Texts EN.StBookstonMystery_CD: A hidden library! And St. Bookston was really Sophia Theodosia Bright! The town will be abuzz for years to come.
Loca_Base Texts EN.FindStBookstonCrest_AD: Keep an eye out for the shards of St. Bookstons family crest. They must be hidden around Bookstonbury!
Loca_Base Texts EN.FindStBookstonCrest_CO: Take the broken crest to Harper.
Loca_Base Texts EN.FindStBookstonCrest_CD: The crest is finally restored! To most of its old glory...
Loca_Base Texts EN.Harper_BookstonMemory_AD: If St. Bookston is so famous, why do we know so little about him? Harper needs to find answers.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Harper_BookstonMemory_SD: Uncover the truth about St. Bookston
Loca_Base Texts EN.Harper_BookstonMemory_CD: Harper will never forget this adventure you went on together!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Errands_01_AD: Supply Tilde with three small courtesies to make her hospital stay more comfortable.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Errands_01_CD: You played a vital part in Tilde's recovery.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Errand_01_-_Board_Games_AD: Fetch an entertaining board game for Tilde and her new friend Giselle from the Méga Marché.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Errand_01_-_Board_Games_SD: Bring a board game to the Hospital
Loca_Base Texts EN.Errand_01_-_Board_Games_CD: BreakKnack! is the newest hit at the orthopaedic centre.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Errand_02_Fish_Sandwich_AD: Walt has made Tilde her comfort food. Can you pick it up at the waterfront and deliver it to her at the hospital?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Errand_02_Fish_Sandwich_SD: Deliver Walt's sandwich to the Hospital
Loca_Base Texts EN.Errand_03_-_Pastry_AD: Pick up Tilde's favourite pastries from Moira at the Liberté to impress the hospital patients.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Errand_03_-_Pastry_CD: Goodness, those strawberry tarts really are delicious.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Business_Sense_AD: Tilde needs to be sure of your business know-how, and she trusts Maryam's assessment above all.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Business_Sense_CO: Show off your new B.L.A.B.L.A. membership to Tilde.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Business_Sense_CD: Tilde truly believes in your knowledge of business, leadership and administration.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Combined_AD: Become worthy of inheriting Tilde's old shop by completing her requirements.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Combined_CO: You're ready. Go and talk to Tilde.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Combined_CD: What's better than one tiny bookshop? Two bookshops, where one is slightly bigger!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Community_Approval_AD: Help your fellow Bookstonians on their journey and unlock the power of true friendship.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Community_Approval_CO: Let's go brag to Tilde about your many cool friends.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Community_Approval_CD: You have some truly amazing people on your side, who will help you through thick and thin.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Sufficient_Gear_T: All the Gear and No Idea
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Sufficient_Gear_AD: You need the proper bookseller's equipment if you want to follow in Tilde's footsteps.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Sufficient_Gear_CO: Let Tilde know you are rich in shelves.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_Shop_Sufficient_Gear_CD: Finally, enough room for all of your books! These shelves are beautiful.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_First_Visit_in_Bookshop_SD: Open your Big Bookshop to the world
Loca_Base Texts EN.Tilde_First_Visit_in_Bookshop_CD: It was nice of Tilde to visit on your first day. Even if she was just keeping tabs on you.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Fern_CollectStories_AD: Call upon your friends around town for some original manuscripts that are worth printing.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Fern_CollectStories_CO: Present the manuscripts you found to Fern.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Fern_CollectStories_CD: Bookstonbury's fiction and folktales are safe with you.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Fern_FundPress_AD: Repairing a piece of 19th-century technology is a costly endeavour.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Fern_FundPress_CD: Restorations have begun thanks to your generous donations.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Fern_PrintingMemory_AD: Fern is really passionate about this new printing press project. Help him restore the old device.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Fern_PrintingMemory_SD: Help Fern restore the printing press
Loca_Base Texts EN.Fern_PrintingMemory_CD: Fern is admired by his fellow Bookstonians for telling their stories and giving them a voice.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Fern_FirstPrint_AD: The old printing press is back in operation. Try it out at the University!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Fern_FirstPrint_CD: Beautiful typeset! And the tasteful lettering... Printing is an art form now no longer lost in Bookstonbury.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Fern_EstablishPrints_AD: The stories are real now. In your hands. In black and white. The people need to read this!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Fern_EstablishPrints_CD: Your name will not be forgotten. Because you printed it on the first page of over $total books.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Moira_7thRule_AD: Ask other business owners for help and find the lost rule from the first B.L.A.B.L.A. compendium.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Moira_7thRule_CD: Another mystery uncovered! What will Maryam think of this?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Moira_VisitWMStall_AD: Drop by the winter market to visit your friend Moira at their stall.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Moira_VisitWMStall_SD: Talk to Moira at the Winter Market
Loca_Base Texts EN.Moira_VisitWMStall_CD: Nothing better than a warm mug and a good friend.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Moria_ReconcileWithMaryam_AD: Moira and Maryam had a big argument. Help them reconcile their differences.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Moria_ReconcileWithMaryam_CD: Wow, these two are much more similar than you (and they) thought.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Maryam_Worthy_Apprentice_CD: You've proven yourself worthy of a coveted B.L.A.B.L.A. membership.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Maryam_Emotional_Support_SD: Be there for Maryam at the Hospital
Loca_Base Texts EN.Maryam_Emotional_Support_CD: Maryam would never admit it, but she was really scared and you were there for her.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Castle_Intro_AD: Drive up to the ruins of the old fort and explore.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Castle_Intro_CD: It feels like you went back in time, doesn't it?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Castle_Scouts01_AD: Show the Pipit Pioneers some scary stories to tell during their campfire nights.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Castle_Scouts01_CD: You gave the pioneers a proper fright. Remember, they're still kids!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Castle_Scouts02_AD: To distract them from their monster obsession, help the pioneers learn about nature.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Castle_Scouts02_SD: Give $total nature or animal recommendations to pioneers
Loca_Base Texts EN.Castle_Scouts02_CD: Looks like you could be a Pioneer Captain yourself, if you wanted to.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Castle_Scouts02_CO: Talk to the pioneers again to find out if they earned their badges yet.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Castle_Scouts01_CO: Seems like the Pioneer Captain wants a word with you at the castle.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Scout_Hiking_Trail_01_AD: Help Anne's Pipit Pioneers excavate an abandoned trail in the Castle Forest.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Scout_Hiking_Trail_01_SD: Sell $total <sprite name="FactIcon" tint=0 color=$FactColor> Fact books at the Castle
Loca_Base Texts EN.Scout_Hiking_Trail_01_CO: See if Anne and her pioneers have found out anything about the trail yet.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Scout_Hiking_Trail_01_CD: The secret around that abandoned hiking trail was lifted!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Scout_Hiking_Trail_02_AD: Collect $total signatures on a petition to the council to approve a new and improved coastal hiking trail.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Scout_Hiking_Trail_02_CD: What used to be a smuggler's secret has now become a magnificent nature trail.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Scout_Hiking_Trail_02_CO: Anne should know that you finished collecting signatures.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Hospital_Intro_AD: Visit the Bookston General Hospital for the first time.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Hospital_Intro_CD: The health care at Bookston General is really top-drawer!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Hospital_Drama_01_AD: Give the staff at the hospital something interesting to talk about. Like books!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Hospital_Drama_01_CO: Talk to the chatterboxes at the hospital to get the latest tea.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Hospital_Drama_01_CD: You're finally privy to Bookston General's juiciest drama.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Hospital_Drama_02_Romance_AD: You could get people into a romantic mood with some recommendations, right?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Hospital_Drama_02_Romance_SD: Recommend $total romance titles at the Hospital
Loca_Base Texts EN.Hospital_Drama_02_Romance_CO: Talk to the hospital staff to get an update on the Jenny situation.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Hospital_Drama_02_Romance_CD: Who knows how many people have found love because of you?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Hospital_Community_Gardening_Fundraiser_: Give out your books for free to fund the community gardening project at the hospital.
Take these funds to Tilde at the hospital.
The healing effects of greenery are not to be underestimated!
Loca_Base Texts EN.Up_to_Code_AD: Show the paramedic that your bookshop is up to code by having at least $total safety items equipped.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Up_to_Code_SD: Equip $total <nobr><sprite name="UI_Safety" tint=0> safety</nobr> items at the Hospital
Loca_Base Texts EN.Up_to_Code_CD: You're up to code! Surely nothing can go wrong now. Right?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Up_to_Code_CO: Talk to the paramedic for inspection.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Lighthouse_Intro_AD: Visit Bookstonbury's iconic tower up on the cliffs for the first time.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Lighthouse_Intro_CD: What have you learned about the mysterious lighthouse?

Loca_Base Texts EN.Letter_TildeHospital01_D:
Oh, how lucky I am to not have to do it all alone. I have neighbours who carried my shopping inside when I couldn’t. I have friends who asked after me, who accompanied me to appointments, and who commiserated with me about feeling old and useless. I have a community full of people who cared, who maintained my garden for me when I couldn’t, who told me they had had the same surgery and that I didn’t need to worry, and who sent flowers and cards to my room today. It’s hard to put onto the page how grateful I feel for all of them.
— Your friend Tilde
Loca_Base Texts EN.Letter_TildeHospital02_D:
I have memories from years ago, a generation ago, and half a century ago, and yet they are only a short walk apart.
Maryam and I met over fifty years ago and thought we had life all figured out. Five years later, Mary had her son Hal. When she called me, we both cried and cried with joy. Twenty-seven years after that, we got the invitation to Hal’s wedding. And when Moira was born a few years later, that was the first time we felt a little old. Five days ago, Maryam called me with instructions for what to pack for my hospital visit, as if I’d never packed my own bags before.
These memories are not far apart at all. They all live on the same street, waving to each other from their front yards.
— Your friend Tilde
Loca_Base Texts EN.Letter_TildeHospital03_D:
Today, I miss my bookshop more than ever. It was always incredibly fulfilling to be able to provide a welcoming, safe place where people wanted to return to. Whether they bought something or not was never the point. It was never about how many sales I made. And I've never believed in "competition". Whoever walked in just needed a warm place to stay for a while. And often, the books they took home weren't what they were looking for when they came in, but what they needed to go on. Rarely do people talk about their troubles directly. But an open ear, someone who would listen, was often worth more than any words of advice I could have given.
— Your friend Tilde
Loca_Base Texts EN.Letter_KlausTour01_D:
Hi mate!
Just writing to tell you that our first stop on tour was a success! The little club we played was brilliant, and it was my first time seeing people mosh to our songs. Holy shit!
Hope you're doing well!
Cheers, Klaus
Loca_Base Texts EN.Letter_KlausTour02_D:
Have you been here before? It's not the prettiest city, but the metal scene is surprisingly big!
I also met Mr. Debvoir and Mr. Walsh for the first time, because they came to say hi. The crowd was rowdy this time, and Lux went stage-diving! I was a bit worried, but all went fine.
Missing you all in B-bury!
Cheers, Klaus
Loca_Base Texts EN.Letter_KlausTour03_D:
Yep, you read that right! Berlin! Holy hells!
It's been a long night, but so worth it! The whole crowd knew our songs!!
But I also hope to get a little more sleep soon, and maybe see more of the city. I should brush up on my German, eh?
Anyway, hope everything is well back home!
Lots of love, Klaus
Loca_Base Texts EN.Letter_KlausTour04_D:
Holy St. Bookston! A lot has happened lately, which I can't even begin to fit on one postcard. But here's my attempt:
Met an agent in Berlin. Got to talking, got drunk, went to karaoke together. She calls back two days later with an offer to open for this huge band. In Japan. We flip out. 2 weeks later, we're on a plane. Played on the biggest stage I've ever seen in my life yesterday. Can't stop shaking. Might be a dream.
Hope I can tell you more soon, since we might be coming back home for a little bit.
Lots of love, Klaus
Loca_Base Texts EN.Letter_StBookstonCrypt_D:
I lost my betrothed at 28 years young. At such youth, and in light of our secret, I felt not the power to speak up when the university claimed her work under the Bookston name. And when the church made a saint of this "Bookston", I could only watch.
With my last power, I gave all that they may not discover our sanctuary here.
Dost thou, in your modern time, dear reader, know the feeling of living with a secret? I hope it isn't so. For then, it may at last be time for her name to be known. Please honour my Sophia.

Yours gratefully,
Audrey Harington-Bright, 1634

Loca_Base Texts EN.Resolution_D:
This setting determines the resolution at which Tiny Bookshop will be displayed.
Higher resolutions provide a clearer image, while being more demanding on your device.
Lower resolutions lead to a blurrier picture overall, while often improving performance on some devices.
In most cases it is preferable to try and keep the resolution as high as possible, and instead lower the 3D Resolution Scaling.
Loca_Base Texts EN.ResolutionScale_D:
This setting adjusts the relative resolution of the 3D game world compared to the user interface.
Lowering this value can improve performance on some devices, especially when using higher resolution screens, while keeping the user interface clear and readable.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Display_D: This setting allows you to adjust on which of the connected screens the game will be displayed.
Loca_Base Texts EN.HideEffectPercentages_D:
This setting hides percentages of effects throughout the game, such as in item descriptions and genre sale chances.
Turn this on if you don't care about pesky percentages and would rather go off vibes.
Loca_Base Texts EN.ShowBookAttributes_D: When enabling this setting, you'll see each book's tags while inspecting a shelf during a recommendation. This can be useful if you've been struggling with identifying a book's contents solely from its description.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Setting_Pause_When_Not_In_Focus: Pause Game When Not in Focus
Loca_Base Texts EN.RunInBackground_D:
When enabled, the game will pause when it is not in focus. This helps reduce power consumption and ensures you don't miss anything.
Turn this off if you want your game to keep running while you are tabbed out or doing something else in windowed mode.
Loca_Base Texts EN.FullscreenMode_D:
This setting allows you to adjust how the game will be displayed on your device. Fullscreen will display the game on your entire screen.
Windowed allows you to resize and move the game around your screen, while having other windows visible, too. Note, this allows you to size the game window in unsupported dimensions. Use at your own risk.
Loca_Base Texts EN.SkipTutorial_D: This setting allows you to disable all in-game explanations through pop-ups or brief interruptions. Note: You will not be able to turn the tutorial back on for this save.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Vsync_D:
This setting synchronises the game's frame rate with the frame rate of your monitor.
Turning it on can help prevent an effect called "screen tearing", where it can look like the image is splitting, especially noticeable on quickly moving large areas.
Turning it off can improve performance on some devices.
Loca_Base Texts EN.TargetFrameRate_D:
This setting controls the maximum images per second this game is being displayed at.
Higher values will make motion throughout the game appear smoother.
Lower values are recommended if you want to save energy. If your device struggles to maintain higher framerates, lowering this value can also help avoid stutters and pauses.
If Vertical Sync is enabled, this value can only be set to compatible values.
Loca_Base Texts EN.AO_D:
This is a visual effect adding shadows between neighbouring objects.
Turning it on improves the visuals of the game.
Turning it off can save a lot of performance on some devices.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Shadows_D:
This setting allows you to adjust the quality of the shadows in Tiny Bookshop.
Lowering the quality or turning off shadows can save a lot of performance on some devices, especially on higher resolution screens.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Overall_Quality_D:
This setting allows you to adjust the overall visual fidelity of Tiny Bookshop.
Lowering the quality can save performance on some devices, while removing some minor visual detail from the game.
Loca_Base Texts EN.AA_D:
This is a visual effect softening the edges of 3D objects on screen. It can prevent edges and lines from flickering, and helps blend everything nicely together.
MSAA 4x leads to best visual results, at a high performance cost on some devices.
Lower or turn off this setting to save performance on some devices.
Loca_Base Texts EN.CameraSpeedGamepad_D: Controls the speed at which the camera moves with the interaction cursor and when using !RightStick to move the camera.
Loca_Base Texts EN.CursorSpeedLocation_D: Controls the speed at which you move the interaction cursor while you're on location.
Loca_Base Texts EN.CursorSpeedTooltip_D: Controls the speed at which you move the interaction cursor while tooltip mode is on.
Loca_Base Texts EN.AxisInversionHorizontalGamepad_D: Inverts camera controls on the horizontal axis.
Loca_Base Texts EN.AxisInversionVerticalGamepad_D: Inverts camera controls on the vertical axis.
Loca_Base Texts EN.HapticStrength_D:
This setting controls the vibration strength of your controller for relevant effects.
Lower or turn off this setting if you want to reduce or eliminate the strength of such effects. Some controllers might not support vibration at all.
Loca_Base Texts EN.CameraDragSpeedMouse_D: Controls the speed at which you move the camera while holding !LeftClick and dragging.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Setting_Color_Adjust: This setting allows you to adjust the colour used to represent this genre throughout the game. This can be helpful to make key information in the game more comfortable to your color perception.
Loca_Base Texts EN.UIScaling_D:
This setting controls the size of 2D interface elements throughout the game, such as this menu, the icons on the side of the screen, texts boxes and pop-ups.
Lower this value to decrease the size of these elements.
Loca_Base Texts EN.EnableHoldButtons_D:
This is a setting for controllers. Some buttons in the game require holding down for a short time.
Turning this off allows you to activate all buttons with a single tap.
Loca_Base Texts EN.CameraSpeedKeyboard_D: Controls the speed at which you move the camera while using the Arrow Keys.
Loca_Base Texts EN.CameraSpeedCorner_D: Controls the speed at which the camera moves while your cursor is at the screen edge.
Loca_Base Texts EN.CameraControlType_D:
Choose how you would like the camera to control. Click and Drag allows you to move the camera by holding !LeftClick and dragging.
Turning on Cursor at Screen Edge will move the camera while your cursor is at the edge of the screen, in that direction. This can be useful if you have trouble holding down !LeftClick.
Allow All enables both movement types. Note that you can also move the camera using the Arrow Keys.
Loca_Base Texts EN.RecommendationAutoAccept_D:
By default, book recommendation requests are not accepted automatically.
Turning this on will automatically start all book recommendations. This is good, if you never want to miss a recommendation, or are having trouble responding in time, but can be jarring and removes control over which requests you want to accept.
Loca_Base Texts EN.RecommendationBubbleDuration_D:
This setting determines how many seconds customers will wait for you to answer their book recommendation requests.
Increasing the value can help if you are having trouble responding in time.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Setting_DefaultConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to change this setting?
Loca_Base Texts EN.Setting_ConfirmSkipTutorial: Are you sure you want to turn off tutorials for this save? You can not turn tutorials back on until your next playthrough.
Loca_Base Texts EN.PauseGameWhenShowingTooltips_D:
When enabled, hovering over a tooltip pauses the game, so you can read in peace.
Turning this off means that time will keep going while inspecting a tooltip.
Loca_Base Texts EN.MasterVolume_D: Controls the overall volume of the game.
Loca_Base Texts EN.MusicVolume_D: Controls the volume of only the music.
Loca_Base Texts EN.UISFXVolume_D: Controls the volume of sounds appearing in the user interface.
Loca_Base Texts EN.WorldSFXVolume_D: Controls the volume of sounds appearing in the game world, such as footsteps.
Loca_Base Texts EN.AmbientSFXVolume_D: Controls the volume of ambient sounds, such as wind and waves.
Loca_Base Texts EN.HideGenreNamesStocking_T: Hide Genre Names While Stocking Books
Loca_Base Texts EN.HideGenreNamesStocking_D: Turning this on hides the genre names on the left side while you are stocking books. This can be good if you want some extra space while you have multiple shelves equipped.
Loca_Base Texts EN.Save_ConfirmDelete: Do you really want to delete this save? This can't be undone.
